title: The 1-2-3 conjecture for polygonal tilings
summary: The 1-2-3 conjecture has been solved positively in 2024 for finite graphs and by extension for infinite graphs which are locally finite. The solution is non-constructive, and finding explicit solutions for large (or infinite) graphs is very hard. By exploiting the extra structure present in many non-periodic tilings, we find explicit solutions for the Chair (all three vertex placements), Non-Pinwheel, Pinwheel, Half-hex, Ammann-Beenker (two versions), Penrose Rhomb, and the Domino tilings.
